dedupe_keys.name: estadistica mensual de pasajeros de metro

description: Estadística mensual de pasajeros de metro is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas. La información del transporte de pasajeros a través de la red Metro de Santiago, es obtenida de los registros administrativos mensuales que entrega la empresa de transporte Metro S.A.. Cumplen proporcionando mensualmente, antecedentes del número de pasajeros usuarios para este tipo de transporte en el país. Coverage: Chile. The portal files it under the publisher Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas. Its tags are Comunicaciones, Consumidor, Economía, Transporte. The portal shows 2021-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Non-Commercial (Any). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
